scenarios.name: Expand and collapse nested entries in the solid-bodies folder

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active in the MCAD Software with one solid body made from an extrusion and sketch
the Solid Bodies folder is collapsed in the model browser
its context menu offers Visibility, Expand All Children and Collapse All Children
the user chooses Expand All Children
the folder displays the body row
the body displays its extrusion and underlying sketch as nested rows
the solid remains visible in the viewport
the user right-clicks Solid Bodies and chooses Collapse All Children
the body row remains visible beneath the folder
the extrusion and sketch rows beneath that body are hidden
the solid remains visible in the viewport
